meta.title: Sweep of November 2026: new people, organisations and ties, each checked against the page it came from
meta.method: Three search sweeps (1-2 Nov 2026) read public pages: Sejm records and transcripts, Justice Ministry contract registers, foundation reports, news articles and parliament pages. Each new tie was kept only when a word-for-word excerpt was found on the cited page and a second reading supported it. Names were matched to existing map nodes where they are the same person or body. Ties that repeat what the map already shows were left out. Each new politician gets their own party or club tie, from a parliament or government page where one was found, otherwise from a news or reference page.
meta.labels: fact = stated on the cited page; alleged = a claim made by a named source; speculation = an inference the page supports only in part.
meta.quotes: quote holds excerpts in the page language; quote_translation is a literal English translation, marked as such.
